notify.title: Wallpaper Carousel
notify.quickshell-missing: Quickshell ('qs') was not found on PATH. The carousel overlay cannot start without it.
notify.start-failed: Could not start the carousel overlay process.

wallpaper-directory.label: Wallpaper Directory
wallpaper-directory.description: Override the directory the carousel browses. Leave empty to follow Noctalia's wallpaper directory.

carousel-mode.label: Carousel Mode
carousel-mode.description: Standard stops at the edges. Wrap loops the index. Infinite shows a seamless repeating view.

apply-to-all-monitors.label: Change All Monitors
apply-to-all-monitors.description: Apply the picked wallpaper to every monitor. Turn off to change only the monitor the carousel was opened on.

preload.label: Start With The Shell
preload.description: Launch the overlay process when Noctalia starts instead of on first use, so the first open is instant.

overlay-opacity.label: Background Dimming
overlay-opacity.description: Opacity of the dark overlay behind the carousel, in percent.

border-width.label: Border Width
border-width.description: Width of the skewed border around thumbnails, in pixels.

corner-radius.label: Corner Radius
corner-radius.description: Corner radius of thumbnails, in pixels. Set to 0 to disable.

item-width.label: Item Width
item-width.description: Width of each wallpaper thumbnail, in pixels.

item-height.label: Item Height
item-height.description: Height of each wallpaper thumbnail, in pixels.

selected-scale.label: Center Tile Zoom
selected-scale.description: Size of the centered tile relative to the surrounding tiles, in percent.

expand-selected.label: Expand Selected
expand-selected.description: Expand the centered tile's width to reveal more of the image.

expand-multiplier.label: Expansion Amount
expand-multiplier.description: Width multiplier applied when the centered tile is expanded, in percent.

enable-hold-expand.label: Hold To Expand
enable-hold-expand.description: Dwell on a tile to trigger a large immersive preview.

hold-expand-ratio.label: Hold Coverage
hold-expand-ratio.description: Screen coverage for the hold preview, in percent.

hold-delay.label: Hold Delay
hold-delay.description: Time to dwell on a tile before the preview activates, in milliseconds.

cache-size.label: Cache Size
cache-size.description: Total number of wallpapers to pre-cache, split evenly before and after the current selection. Reduce to save memory on large collections.
